stem:
Lalit draws two straight lines on the same flat board. However far he extends them, they never meet, and the distance between them stays the same.

What can he conclude?

options.text: Call them same plane as the full answer, without deciding whether they are parallel.
Call them parallel even if they need not lie on the same plane.
The lines are parallel: they lie on the same plane and do not meet when extended.
Call them parallel only because the printed word distance stands out in the stem.

teacher.key_rationale: Parallel lines lie on the same plane and never meet when extended. Naming same plane alone, dropping the same-plane condition, or deciding from a standout printed word all miss that test.
